svg.title: LLMFence
svg.text: Clean 1 KB prompt, release build on Apple Silicon.
12.7 µs when the prompt contains PII.
Precision and recall on 65 labeled cases, hard negatives included
Accuracy on 88 cases; the 3 misses are listed by llmfence eval
Added to a typical LLM call
190 µs for a 16 KB prompt against hundreds of ms of model time
